scope: Conceptual audit of the four-family split-calibrated baseline protocol
verdict: Defensible with the recorded conditions; not a review of empirical conclusions
conditions: Candidate construction and static candidate order use fit data only. Adaptive threshold order is prespecified, not selected using observed test costs.
LTT/CRC guarantees apply separately to each family and setting; choosing a winning family after calibration requires additional control.
CRC uses the per-instance running maximum of disagreement losses and an identical zero-loss full fallback.
Pruned-transform costs are shared structural proxies charging touched dilations, touched units, retained PPVs, and evaluated heads.
POCKET preserves centered column-L2 normalization, final positive-shrinkage support and 50 iterations.
SFD preserves every 5-percent elimination/refit step, fixed alpha and maximum absolute class coefficient, without reentry.
caveats: POCKET three-fold tuning at 32-percent retention and shared k are declared adaptations, not fully retuned published POCKET at each budget.
Merged UCR resplits do not permit direct comparison to published official-split benchmark scores.
Existing benchmark-guided method design makes this an exploratory paired comparison, not a fresh confirmatory evaluation.
Pooled OOF plus calibration has no proved risk bound in this project; empirical risk and failure to reject cannot validate a guarantee.
Modeled operations cannot establish measured runtime speedups. Full fallback is always safe even when no non-full candidate passes.
